item.title: Email experiments: filtering out external images
item.description:
📝 Most email I receive references externally loaded images via HTML. So I had a realization that, if I wanted to naturally filter email that was sent by hand from email sent from an automated system, this might be a decent proxy for that. Probably you'll want to have another rule that prevents you from running this for email from people in your contacts.
🔗 Read more: https://www.terracrypt.net/posts/email-experiments-image-filtering.html
